# Contract fixtures

- `openapi-subset.json`: the operations Granary uses and every schema they reference, copied from
  `silo-server/contracts/api/v2/openapi.json@6791aac` (AGPL-3.0-or-later) by `node scripts/extract-oas-subset.mjs`.
  Regenerate after re-pinning the upstream SHA; keep the operation list in sync with docs/research/silo-api.md.
- `*.json`: sanitized response bodies. Values are synthetic (built from the OAS `examples`), never recorded from a real
  server with real tokens. `tests/contract.rs` validates every fixture against the subset schema
  (`required`, `additionalProperties: false`, types, enums), then serves it from a local mock server to the real
  HTTP client.
- Phase 5 browse/detail/watch fixtures (`home_sections.json`, `catalog_browse.json`, `catalog_item.json`,
  `series_seasons.json`, `season_episodes.json`, `watch_detail.json`) are generated by
  `node scripts/gen-catalog-fixtures.mjs`: schema placeholders for every required field plus synthetic values.
- `upstream_*.json` (Phase 6, playback protocol v3): copied verbatim from
  `silo-server/contracts/api/v2/fixtures/<name>.json@6791aac` (AGPL-3.0-or-later). Upstream generates them from its own
  synthetic test server (`internal/apiv2/playback_fixtures_test.go@6791aac`), so they contain only placeholder ids and
  tokens. Granary validates them against the subset again and decodes them with its own types.
- 0.2 fixtures (`person.json`, `library_collections.json`, `catalog_item_collection.json`, `catalog_filters.json`) are
  hand-written synthetic bodies; `listLibrarySections` reuses `home_sections.json` (both are `SectionCollection`).
